chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Kufi, from Bashshar ibn Ahmad al-Basri, from ‘Ali ibn ‘Umar al-Nawfali, who said:

I was with Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام in the courtyard of his house, when Muhammad, his son, passed by us. So I said to him: ‘May I be sacrificed for you, is this one our master after you?’ He said: ‘No. Your master after me is al-Hasan.’

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, the Imam speaking in the report
key_terms.الْحَسَنُ: al-Hasan, identified here as the successor after him
key_terms.جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ: a respectful expression meaning 'may I be sacrificed for you'
key_terms.صَاحِبُنَا: our master or leader after the Imam
key_terms.صَحْنِ دَارِهِ: the courtyard of his house, the setting of the event
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٌ ابْنُهُ: Muhammad, his son, whose status is being asked about

ai.seo_question: Which son did Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام designate as the Imam after him?
ai.summary: This hadith records a clear designation by Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام regarding who would hold authority after him. It identifies al-Hasan عليه السلام, not Muhammad, as the Imam after him, making it significant in discussions of Imamate and divinely designated leadership within the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Kufy, from Bashhar Bin Ahmad Al Basry, from Ali Bin Umar Al Nowfaly who said,

‘I was with Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> in the courtyard of his<sup>asws</sup> house, so Muhammad his<sup>asws</sup> son passed by us. So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! This one would be our Master after you<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. Your Master<sup>asws</sup> after me<sup>asws</sup> is Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Kufi from Bashshar ibn Ahmad al-Basri from Ali ibn ‘Umar al-Nawfali who has said the following.

“Once I was with abu al-Hassan in the compound of his house and at that time his son, Muhammad passed by. I said to him, “may Allah take my souls in service for your cause, will he be our master, Imam, after you?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “ No, your master, Imam, after me will be al-Hassan (a.s.).” * This abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn Ali, is the eldest son of the Imam al-Hadi (a.s.).He died before his father (230/845 - 252/866). His shrine is near Balad which is near Baghdad, and the place is now known as al-Sayyid Muhammad. In the following ahadith his name is frequently mentioned.
